basics.name: Omri Ben-Dov
basics.label: PhD student
basics.summary: PhD student at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems working on principled objectives and optimization for generative modeling and learning under strategic behavior.

work.name: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Tübingen, Germany
work.summary: Research on principled objectives for generative modeling and strategic interaction in machine learning systems. Recent work includes adaptive symmetrization of the KL divergence, stable likelihood-based training for one-way flows, and collective-action methods for fairness. Supervised by Samira Samadi and Amartya Sanyal; prior work in the Perceiving Systems department on articulated 3D rat models with Michael J. Black, Silvia Zuffi, and Sergi Pujades.

work.name: Weizmann Institute of Science, Rehovot, Israel
work.summary: Applied signal processing and matched filtering on gravitational-wave data to detect binary black holes. Worked with Barak Zackay.

work.name: The Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Jerusalem, Israel
work.summary: Developed an algorithm to estimate kinematic parameters of free-flying flies from video using a 3D model. Supervised by Tsevi Beatus.

work.name: Intel, Petah Tikva, Israel
work.summary: Developed and maintained scripts for automated testing and quality assurance.
